description.zh:
风险等级。取值：
- **high**：表示高危。
- **medium**：表示中危。
- **low**：表示低危。
description.en:
The risk level. Valid values:
- **high**: high risk.
- **medium**: medium risk.
- **low**: low risk.

description.zh:
风险类型。
> 您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~)获取支持的风险类型。
description.en:
The risk type.
> You can call the [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) operation to query the supported risk types.
The API operation associated with the risk.
The ID of the API associated with the risk.

description.zh:
API的业务用途。
> 您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~)获取支持的业务用途。
description.en:
The business purpose of the API.
> You can call the [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) operation to query the supported business purposes.

description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.
The domain name or IP address to which the API operation belongs.

description.zh:
排序字段的名称。取值：
- **discoverTime**：表示风险首次检出时间（默认）。
- **abnormalLevel**：表示风险等级。
- **latestDiscoverTime**：表示风险最近检出时间。
description.en:
The name of the field used for sorting. Valid values:
- **discoverTime**: the time when the risk was first detected. This is the default value.
- **abnormalLevel**: the risk level.
- **latestDiscoverTime**: the time when the risk was most recently detected.

description.zh:
排序的方式。取值：
- **desc**：表示降序（默认）。
- **asc**：表示升序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:
- **desc**: descending order. This is the default value.
- **asc**: ascending order.

description.zh:
风险类型的来源。取值：
- **custom**：表示自定义。
- **default**：表示内置。
description.en:
The source of the risk type. Valid values:
- **custom**: custom.
- **default**: built-in.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
风险状态。取值：
- **toBeConfirmed**：表示待确认。
- **confirmed**：表示已确认。
- **toBeFixed**：表示待修复。
- **fixed**：表示已修复（人工验证）。
- **ignored**：表示忽略。
- **toBeVerified**：表示待系统验证。
- **notFixed**：表示验证未修复。
- **systemFixed**：表示已修复（系统验证）。
description.en:
The risk status. Valid values:
- **toBeConfirmed**: to be confirmed.
- **confirmed**: confirmed.
- **toBeFixed**: to be fixed.
- **fixed**: fixed (manually verified).
- **ignored**: ignored.
- **toBeVerified**: to be verified by the system.
- **notFixed**: not fixed after verification.
- **systemFixed**: fixed (verified by the system).
